title: Joint Continuity and Selberg--ODE Equivalence for the $\mathrm{Sine}_β$ Pair Correlation Function
summary: We address two questions posed by Qu and Valkó in their study of the pair correlation function of the $\mathrm{Sine}_β$ process. First, we prove that the pair correlation function admits a jointly continuous version in the inverse-temperature and spatial parameters on $(0,\infty)\times\mathbb{R}$, removing the restriction $β>2$ in their joint-continuity result. The argument uses a general observation: separate weak continuity of a family of probability laws, together with stochastic monotonicity in one parameter, implies joint weak continuity.
